overview: 公司于2026年进行首次公开募股（IPO），并在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市，发行91,867,000股新股。除此之外，公告中未提及其他业务板块的具体变化。
overview_en: The company conducted an initial public offering (IPO) in 2026 and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad, issuing 91,867,000 new ordinary shares. Apart from this, the announcements do not mention any specific changes in other business segments.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成首次公开募股并在ACE市场上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its initial public offering and listed on the ACE Market in 2026.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF YES GROUP MANAGEMENT BERHAD ("YES" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MARKET OF BUR
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股，公开发行91,867,000股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市。
actions.text_en: The company conducted an initial public offering of 91,867,000 new ordinary shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
